title: Colts are now open to trading RB Jonathan Taylor, and the Broncos are among the teams interested

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts are now open to trading RB Jonathan Taylor, and the Broncos are among the teams interested
sources.description: According to NFL insiders Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport, the Indianapolis Colts are now open to trading star running back Jonathan Taylor ahead of the upcoming trade deadline. In the report, both insiders list the Broncos among the teams that have shown some level of interest in trading for the star running back. The Colts […]
